function.name: list_vetclaw_skills
function.description: List available VetClaw veterinary skills (name, category, description). Call first to discover which skill to load.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring matched against name/description.

function.name: get_vetclaw_skill
function.description: Return the full markdown of a VetClaw skill by name (e.g. 'toxicology-calculator'). Load the relevant skill before reasoning about a veterinary case.

function.name: search_veterinary_adverse_events
function.description: Search the FDA openFDA animal & veterinary adverse-event database. Filter by species, drug, breed, and/or reaction.

species.description: e.g. DOG, CAT, HORSE, CATTLE, BIRD

function.name: top_adverse_reactions
function.description: Count the most-reported adverse reactions for a species (optionally a drug).
